title: Compliance status validity period is very short

minDays.text: Days below which normal absence starts to block users

messages.businessImpact: Devices switched off over a holiday or a long weekend return marked non-compliant and blocked, generating service desk calls that have nothing to do with security.
remediation: Raise the compliance status validity period to at least seven days.
messages.cannotSee: A tenant that reports no validity period at all reads as zero here and is left alone, because zero is the absence of an answer rather than a very short one.
